caption: A car with a dragging exhaust pipe drives down a road at night, and sparks trail behind it where the pipe scrapes the asphalt.

sa.check: A car drives along a road at night.
Its exhaust pipe hangs down and drags on the road.
Sparks trail behind the car where the pipe scrapes the asphalt.
The sparks come from the pipe's contact point, low at the back of the car.
The scrape comes first and the sparks trail after.

pc.expect: The sparks stream backward from the contact point along the road, opposite to the car's motion, low over the surface, and die out along the way.
pc.fail: Sparks fly ahead of the car; or spray equally in all directions; or the trail moves along with the car as a fixed cloud; or the trail lies off to one side while the car runs straight.

pc.expect: Sparks are transient and leave nothing on the road; one car with one dragging pipe.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the road behind the car for the rest of the clip; or a glowing line remains along the road; or the pipe vanishes or duplicates; or a second car appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only while the pipe touches the road and stop when it lifts or the car stops.
pc.fail: Sparks continue after the car has stopped; or sparks trail from a pipe that is clearly off the road; or sparks flow back into the pipe.

pc.expect: Sparks that lift off the road arc back down and go dark; none rise or hover.
pc.fail: Sparks rise steadily and gather above the car; or hang in the air; or climb up the car's back.

pc.expect: The pipe scrapes the road's surface; the car stays whole and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The pipe sinks into the asphalt; or the car passes through another vehicle or a barrier; or the pipe detaches and floats; or the car changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The car's colour and lights, the road markings and the roadside stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or its lights change layout; or the road markings change.

note: The car is a driven vehicle; its speed and steering are not judged.
